rationale: Mandatory national e-procurement portal; densest single source of MK banking/payments vendor and contract evidence.
Institution-scoped contract grid inside e-nabavki; a query view of the parent portal, not a standalone source.
Per-procedure dossier template page on e-nabavki; the atomic evidence unit but covered by monitoring the parent.
Undocumented ASMX endpoints of the same portal; valuable as a collection method, not a separate source.
Training mirror of the production portal; no real award data and liveness unverified.
Procurement Bureau site publishes framework, statistics and annual reports underpinning completeness of A6 evidence.
MoF explainer page about ESJN modules; static context already covered by BJN/e-nabavki, and URL unverified.
Appeals register exposes losing bidders and annulled awards in IT/payments tenders — competitor set not visible elsewhere.
State Audit reports narrate central-bank/institution IT and payment procurements with vendor names and values; reuse terms to confirm.
NBRSM's own procurement stream covers national payment infrastructure; failed check is soft, re-verify liveness.
National open-data portal potentially carrying bulk ESJN concluded-contracts dataset — cheapest structured vendor route.
Ministry policy page; thin standalone signal for A6 and URL unverified.
Leading procurement watchdog publishing recurring monitoring reports and tender case studies naming authorities and suppliers.
NGO open-data platform republishing cleaned procurement datasets; useful validation/backfill layer for scraped ESJN records.
Civic-tech scraper repo documenting dossier endpoints; mine once for method and historical dumps, not a signal stream.
EU procurement hub page; the substantive MK notices arrive via TED, which is tracked separately.
Generic stand-in for many authority mirror pages; mine for full technical specs, but needs per-authority expansion before monitoring.
Private practitioner guidance site; low credibility, only helps decode portal fields.
FOI platform is a fallback acquisition route rather than a producing source; reuse terms unclear.
News tag feed on the procurement bureau surfaces award controversies and vendor relationships ahead of the formal record.
OGP commitment tracker gives policy context on open-data publishing but almost no vendor signal.
TED carries above-threshold MK notices and award notices in English with winner, value and CPV — key for international payments/core-banking vendors.
ECEPP is the sole channel for EBRD-financed notices in MK banking projects; likely requires registration to browse fully.
EBRD corporate index page pointing into ECEPP; adds little beyond the portal itself.
EBRD MK country/project pipeline names client banks and TC consultants months before procurement notices appear.
Machine-readable World Bank contract-award dataset with supplier name, country and value for MK; highest-yield structured vendor identity source.
Single STEP procurement-plan document — forward pipeline evidence; monitor the WB documents search rather than this URL.
